diagnosis: The case split for applications is adequate, but the resulting subset obligations and the analogous quantifier/conditional/equality obligations remain as elementary propositional goals. Running `grind` over all residual goals uses the induction hypotheses, while the impossible `default` membership branch is discharged by reduction.
proof_body:
by
  intro Hnorm
  induction Hnorm <;>
    simp_all [extractOldExprVars,
      Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars,
      Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars,
      List.Subset]
  case app =>
    try unfold extractOldExprVars
    repeat
      split <;>
        simp_all [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars,
          Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars,
          List.Subset]
  all_goals grind
